prerequisites: BASIC ELEMENTS OF THE STRUCTURE OF MATTER

learning_outcomes.text: The course aims to provide the basic concepts on the structure, mechanical behavior and properties of metal alloys, even after heat treatment, used for the production of structural components in the manufacturing industry.
The aim is to direct students to understand the connections between the properties of materials, their transformations and the possibilities of use in the various fields of engineering.
Characteristics and structure of metallic materials
Influence of heat treatments on the mechanical characteristics of metal alloys
Read and interpret the state diagram of a two-component system.
Determine the stress-strain curves from the machine diagram of a tensile test.
Interpret the results of mechanical characterization tests.
Know how to choose the appropriate mechanical test and know how to interpret the results for the purpose of selecting materials.
Able to describe, in written form, concisely and orally present with language skills the objectives, the procedure and the results of the elaborations carried out.
Able to apply the knowledge acquired to contexts different from those presented during the course and examine in depth the topics covered using materials other than those proposed.

syllabus_topics: METALLIC MATERIALS: THE PRODUCT TO BE MANUFACTURED AND THE STUDY OF MATERIALS. THE SOLID STATE: CRYSTAL LATTICES AND LATTICE DEFECTS

MECHANICAL BEHAVIOR OF METALLIC MATERIALS: FORCES AND STRESSES, UNIAXIAL LOADS. PLASTIC DEFORMATION MECHANISMS. WORK HARDENING MECHANISMS, EFFECT OF TEMPERATURE AND SPEED. HOT AND COLD PLASTIC DEFORMATIONS. ELASTIC DEFORMATION WORK AND PLASTIC DEFORMATION WORK

METAL ALLOYS AND STEELS: SOLID SUBSTITUTIONAL AND INTERSTITIAL SOLUTIONS. LAW OF PHASES. BINARY STATE DIAGRAMS. THE IRON-CARBON SYSTEM. NUCLEATION AND GROWTH OF GRAINS. DIAGRAMS OF AN ISOTHERMAL PHASE TRANSFORMATION. DIFFUSION IN THE SOLID STATE, SEGREGATION PHENOMENA
HEAT TREATMENTS: CLASSIFICATION OF HEAT TREATMENTS OF METAL ALLOYS. HEAT TREATMENTS OF STEELS, MARTENSITIC TRANSFORMATION AND THERMAL HYSTERESIS, TTT DIAGRAMS
MECHANICAL TESTS: BRINELL, VICKERS, KNOOP AND ROCKWELL HARDNESS TESTS. MICROHARDNESS TEST. IMPACT TEST. TENSILE TEST: SIZING TEST PIECES, UNIT LOADS AND CHARACTERISTIC VALUES, TEST REPORTS
assessment_rules: The exam consists of a written test and a compulsory oral test. The written test is considered passed if the student reaches at least 18/30. The final grade is determined by the average of the written test and the oral test; a sufficient grade is achieved if the student shows knowledge of the mechanical behavior of metallic materials, the iron-carbon diagram and the heat treatments of steels. Honors are awarded at the discretion of the teacher if the student shows autonomous processing skills and logical connection between the topics of the course.
